status: fixed diagnostic counterfactuals; no strategy promotion or runtime hard obligations
root: P12 order1 vol_k1; sigma=rolling(session_bars) population std(ddof=0) of close log differences, unshifted. min_periods=session_bars (warmup alternatives account-equivalent in development).
primary_objective: reduce maximum drawdown; annualized return sacrifice explicitly permitted by user
required_comparator: same full account and costs, including equal-average-absolute-exposure constant scaling

features.work_amplitude: population rolling one-session standard deviation of work
features.slow: causal first-order Butterworth, cutoff20 trading sessions
features.reversals: number of nonzero baseline direction reversals in past one_session
features.one_session: 48 bars for offset0, 46 bars for offsets1-4; sensitivity only, not independent markets

experiments.mechanism: stable slow displacement exceeds working oscillation amplitude, while tactical holding opposes slow drift
poor working-path efficiency together with repeated reversals

additional_controls: For each experiment and each evaluation interval, retrospective constant mean exposure; explicitly nondeployable matching benchmark, never a selected runtime policy.
timing: close[t] sets target at next bar open; return ending at open[i] uses target[i-2]. Charge changes at actual execution open; terminal liquidation at last scored open. Carry warmup signal state but reset scored account flat at first scored open.
sequential_review: Baseline descriptive evidence may reconstruct full consumed history. Candidate experiments are opened and manually reviewed one natural year at a time; no year-dependent runtime rule, parameter search or mid-study retuning. Same fixed whole policies in all five sessions.
interpretation: These are diagnostic interventions on an index-point model. A raw unresolved condition has no hard-veto authority. Improvements may be retained but no successor is promoted in this first attribution round. No live trading, fresh OOS or guaranteed risk limit.
promotion_status: not_requested_for_this_round; mechanism replication, causal data availability and tradable implementation remain separate gates

randomness_reference.meaning: exchangeability order reference; not an exact test of nonstationary structural causes
